title: Guardians at the gate: cMAF keeps the brain’s vasculature in check
title_zh: 守门人：cMAF 维持脑血管平衡
abstract: In this issue of Cell, Brioschi et al. identify cellular musculoaponeurotic fibrosarcoma (cMAF) as a key regulator of brain perivascular macrophages that supports cerebrovascular function through insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF1) production. This cMAF-IGF1 program is enhanced in Alzheimer's disease (AD), potentially reflecting a protective response that is lost in APOE4 carriers.
abstract_zh: Brioschi 等人在本期 Cell 期刊中确定，细胞肌肉骨骼纤维瘤样纤维化蛋白 (cMAF) 是脑周围巨噬细胞的关键调节因子，通过产生胰岛素样生长因子 1 (IGF1) 支持血管功能。该 cMAF-IGF1 通路在阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 中得到增强，这可能反映了一种在 APOE4 携带者中丢失的保护性反应。
